anti_loop.new_successor_obligation: Use explicit-table factors and refuse any elimination bucket before expansion unless its raw row-combination upper bound is <= L^2. This converts the old finite resource cap into a frozen original-input polynomial admission envelope; no claim is made for overbudget buckets.

scope: RAW_EXPLICIT_BOOLEAN_RELATION_INPUT; CANONICAL_MINCUT_PARENT_RETURNS OPEN_MINCUT_BRANCH_BUDGET WITH ZERO RAW CUT BRANCHES; SEALED RAW/COMPOSITIONAL BASIS DOES NOT ALREADY ADMIT THE INSTANCE; AT LEAST ONE CUT COMPONENT HAS >=3 RELATIONS; PREDECESSOR TWO-RELATION GATE RETURNS OPEN_COMPONENT_RELATION_COUNT_GT_2; EXACT ELIMINATION USES THE FROZEN CANONICAL VARIABLE ORDER AND A QUADRATIC PRE-EXPANSION BUCKET PRODUCT BUDGET L^2.

fixed_budget.canonical_input_length: L = max(2, byte length of canonical JSON encoding)
fixed_budget.guard: For every variable-elimination bucket with current explicit factors F1..Ft, compute product_i |Fi| with early stop. If product > L^2, return OPEN_BUCKET_PRODUCT_BUDGET before constructing any Cartesian row combination for that bucket.
fixed_budget.output_bound: A successful bucket creates at most product_i |Fi| <= L^2 compatible merged rows before projection/deduplication, so each new factor has <= L^2 rows.
fixed_budget.uniformity: At most O(L) variables are eliminated. Each admitted bucket enumerates <= L^2 combinations; each compatibility/merge touches at most O(L) factors and O(L) tuple cells. A conservative fixed polynomial lifecycle/certificate bound O(L^6) is sufficient and its exponent does not depend on relation count.

formal_mechanism.phase_1_component_elimination: Using the canonical mincut B, process each cut-separated component independently. Eliminate component-private variables in increasing variable-id order. At each variable, collect every current factor containing it, pre-check the L^2 row-product budget, natural-join only if admitted, existentially project the variable, deduplicate output rows, and retain one witness eliminated value per output tuple.
formal_mechanism.boundary_portfolio: After all private variables are eliminated, retain the resulting explicit factors over subsets of B. Do not force a full-B materialized boundary relation.
formal_mechanism.phase_2_boundary_elimination: Union all residual boundary factors from all components and eliminate cut variables in increasing canonical order using the identical L^2 pre-expansion guard. This solves the conjunction without enumerating the 2^|B| boundary cube.
formal_mechanism.exactness: Each bucket replacement is exact existential variable elimination: exists x conjunction(bucket factors) is represented by the deduplicated projected compatible-row join. Factors not in the bucket are unchanged.
formal_mechanism.reconstruction: For every produced output tuple store one chosen compatible bucket witness for the eliminated variable. Reverse the elimination records from the final zero-arity SAT row to reconstruct all variables, then verify every original relation against its explicit allowed rows.
formal_mechanism.fail_closed: Any overbudget bucket returns OPEN before its combinations are enumerated. No alternative elimination order, heuristic retry or exponential search is permitted in this gate.

negative_controls.construction: Use the positive control but replace the right boundary relation by a singleton cut state incompatible with the left component support.

Start from the positive topology and add many mixed OR-like/XOR-like relations sharing the private Y block so the first private-variable bucket has an explicit row-count product > L^2 while the parent remains overwidth and predecessor-open.
